name: shipdeck
description: ShipShape's companion mod: refines dictated prompts before the session reads them, and keeps a band above the prompt with the session's seat, context and evidence. Reads and displays; never gates.

refine.title: Refine dictated prompts
refine.description: Rewrite a long dictated prompt into a structured one (with Sonnet 5.5) before the session reads it. Start a prompt with raw: to skip one.

style.title: Band style
style.description: github: icons beside plain labels, a thin context bar. linear: hairline chips, a pie for context.
